name: Effective Range / Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression
proof: Retain all active-coordinate examples and reconstruct a fixed least class member consistent with them. The retained examples include their observed labels, so the reconstruction is proper and consistent; inactive examples are irrelevant. The retained size is at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\).
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, effective range is $n$ while proper unlabeled sample compression size is 1.
